sources.name: Chainguard Free Python OCI image index

evidence.note: The anonymous publisher-registry probe resolves the exact OCI index digest and identifies linux/amd64 manifest sha256:15e66fa35e0b07095bbc4f4f0522718b780944709026687485f4e712cc6d5ae0 plus linux/arm64 manifest sha256:139d6148422e5861af57c8db819551ece94cb3ef9bbbc9e9153668394fd316cb.
Chainguard's current directory identifies python as packaged by Chainguard at cgr.dev/chainguard/python.

criteria.note: Publisher, repository, immutable index, and selected linux/amd64 manifest are exact.

evidence.note: The primary publisher directory names Chainguard as packager and publishes the registry reference, rootless user, entrypoint, and OCI configuration.
Chainguard's official category guide identifies Python as a Base Container intended to be extended by users.

criteria.note: The primary publisher controls both the registry artifact and its intended base-image use.

evidence.note: The exact digest is anonymously resolvable from cgr.dev without account, secret, terms acceptance, or fee.
The publisher states that Free Containers are publicly available without authentication for download and use.

criteria.note: Only public anonymous access to this exact digest is approved; paid, private, or authenticated images remain outside authority.

evidence.note: The publisher states that Free Containers are free to use for everyone and that Base Containers, including Python, are meant to be extended by users.

criteria.note: The approved use is local extension and verification only. Neither the base image nor a derived image may be uploaded, published, or redistributed by this checkpoint.

evidence.note: The publisher registry returns the linux/amd64 manifest and Chainguard annotations, including image title, vendor, author, source, URL, and creation time 2026-08-09T04:38:19Z.

evidence.locator: Docker local image store on desktop-linux
evidence.note: The cached descriptor, RepoDigest, author github.com/chainguard-dev/apko, eleven layer identities, annotations, size 26150256 bytes, and root filesystem identity agree with the exact publisher index and selected platform manifest.

criteria.note: Custody is the already cached publisher image; no intermediary or mutable tag is admitted.

evidence.note: The remote OCI index resolves to the same sha256 descriptor as the local RepoDigest; the linux/amd64 manifest fixes config sha256:a22ecca0c885020dd8692b49c607d401cdf6750c61388352cb7f8d2db3758169 and eleven content-addressed layer digests.

criteria.note: OCI content digests bind the exact admitted bytes. Cosign signature verification is supported by the publisher but was not performed because no reviewed Cosign executable is installed; no signature claim is made or needed for the narrower digest-bound gate.

evidence.note: The cached 54-package SBOM contains Python 3.14.7, SQLite 3.53.4, OpenSSL 3.6.3, glibc 2.43, and CA certificates. Python 3.14.7 satisfies Runbook Sentinel's frozen Python >=3.12 requirement.
The image has no shell or package manager, defaults to UID 65532, enters through /usr/bin/python, and the application has no runtime dependency beyond the Python standard library.

criteria.note: Fitness is conditional on exact container build, CLI, evaluation, API, MCP, persistence, telemetry, dashboard, and non-root runtime verification; this gate does not pre-claim those outcomes.

evidence.locator: Docker Scout CLI 1.20.4 local scan at exact digest
evidence.note: The current local scan indexes 54 packages and reports 0 critical, 0 high, 0 medium, and 0 low vulnerabilities.
The container remains synthetic-only, receives no secrets, uses no real operational connector, runs as non-root, and preserves all model, approval, capability, executor, and MCP authority boundaries.

criteria.note: Vulnerability status is observation-time evidence, not a perpetual CVE-free claim. Network, privilege, filesystem, credential, and real-infrastructure restrictions must be verified outside the model.
